chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) judged regarding a maternal aunt who came disputing over the slave of a man who had died.
And those of relationship are protection of one another in the Book of Allah
So he handed over the inheritance to the maternal aunt and did not give it to the master.
ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali determine inheritance priority between a maternal aunt and a mawla?
ai.summary: In this ruling from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) prioritized the maternal aunt over the freed slave (mawla) by interpreting the phrase 'those of relationship' (ulu al-arham) in Surah Al-Ahzab 33:6 as referring to blood kinship rather than the manumission bond. This establishes a key Shia jurisprudential principle that natural lineage takes precedence over acquired familial ties in inheritance distribution, distinguishing it from the status of the mawla who, while connected, does not share the same degree of consanguinity.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a maternal aunt who came disputing regarding the slave of a man who had died.
So heasws read this Verse [33:6] and the possessors of relationships some of them are closer to others in the Book of Allah
– so he<sup>asws</sup> handed over the inheritance to the maternal aunt and did not give it to the master’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu Najran from ‘Asem ibn Humayd from Muhammad ibn Qays who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
’ Amir al-Mu’minin, issued a judgment in the case of a maternal aunt who disputed against a Mawla’ (master) of a man who had died.
He read this verse, . the relatives have priority over each other according to the book of Allah.’ [33:6]
He (the Imam) gave the legacy to the maternal aunt instead of the Mawla ’ (Master).”’
